subject: Final reconciliation: Q1 retro usage & one-time settlement
messages:
From: Andrew Liu <andrew.liu@novaworks.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicole Reyes <finance@novaworks.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 retro usage reconciliation request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the help during our Q1 pilot ramp — appreciate the responsiveness from the Redwood team. We ran over our committed inference hours in March as the product team pushed a late feature, and Nicole needs to reconcile the overage for our finance close.

Can you share the retrospective usage worksheet and a proposed settlement charge? We expect to split the one-time invoice across two POs (one for March overage and one for an incremental capacity top-up) and would prefer itemized line items so our AP team can code them correctly.

Also: we flagged a small discrepancy on a handful of sessions (see brief note in the attached summary) — if you can confirm whether those were billed as cached vs compute tokens that would help.

Thanks,
Andrew
Andrew Liu
Head of Platform
Novaworks Ltd.

Attachments: none in this message

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Liu <andrew.liu@novaworks.com>, Nicole Reyes <finance@novaworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retro usage reconciliation request

Hi Andrew / Nicole —

Thanks for the heads up. I pulled the Q1 usage reports and reconciled the March burst window you referenced. I’m attaching a detailed worksheet (NW-2027Q1-retro-usage-worksheet.xlsx) that breaks down: committed hours, burst/overage hours, cache hit adjustments, and the per-token/compute cost used for the invoicing calculator.

Quick summary:
- Committed capacity: 150k inference hours for Q1
- Actual billed hours: 182,400 (includes pilot burst from Mar 14–22)
- Overage: 32,400 inference hours
- Proposed settlement: one-time charge for 32,400 hours less a 10% courtesy credit (applied per our renewal discussion) = 29,160 billable hours

Ben, can you propose an invoice split and confirm tax treatment for the US entity? We’ll also need a PO for each line.

I’ll hold off on issuing an invoice until we align on the split. If you prefer a credit on next month’s invoice vs immediate one-off, we can scope that as well — but AP indicated they prefer discrete POs.

Cheers,
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: NW-2027Q1-retro-usage-worksheet.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Andrew Liu <andrew.liu@novaworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retro usage reconciliation request

Team —

Reviewed the worksheet. Proposed settlement mechanics:
1) Invoice A (March overage): 29,160 billable hours * $0.045/hr = $1,312.20 (note: numbers rounded to dollars on final invoice).
2) Invoice B (Capacity top-up): separate line for the incremental 50k reserved hours from Apr–Jun (pro-rated at the contracted monthly rate) — optics for Novaworks AP to code to a capitalized capacity budget.
3) Tax: US sales tax not applicable for software-inference services in CA per our current nexus; will include tax note on the invoice, but final determination with Novaworks tax is recommended.

Laura, can you approve applying the 10% courtesy credit and sign off on issuing Redwood-invoice-20270428.pdf once Olga confirms PO numbers?

Also Andrew — the session-level discrepancy you mentioned: the worksheet flags 18 sessions where KV cache eviction caused extra compute. We can mark those as cache-miss charges; if you’d like we can subtract them as part of the goodwill credit (we absorbed similar last year for another customer). Would you prefer us to apply that reduction?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Andrew Liu <andrew.liu@novaworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicole Reyes <finance@novaworks.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retro usage reconciliation request

Hi Ben / Olga —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Two quick asks from my side:
1) Please apply the cache-eviction reduction — those 18 sessions were internal test runs and we don’t expect to be charged for them.
2) We will supply two PO numbers by EOD Friday (PO-MAR-442 and PO-APR-TOPUP-77). If you can split the invoice accordingly that’s ideal.

Nicole: I’m looping you here to confirm the PO flow.

Appreciate the flexibility on the credit.

—Andrew

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retro usage reconciliation request

Olga / Ben —

Approved: apply the 10% courtesy credit and remove the 18-session cache-eviction charge as goodwill. Final billable hours: 29,160 - (18 sessions equivalent) — see the attached calc in the worksheet for the precise adjustment. Ben, please reflect the reduction and prepare the PDF invoice with two payable line items (Invoice A + Invoice B).

I will add a short note on the invoice footer: "Settlement agreed per account executive note; courtesy credit applied as per renewal negotiations."

Laura
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Liu <andrew.liu@novaworks.com>, Nicole Reyes <finance@novaworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 retro usage reconciliation request — final invoice and PO instructions

Andrew / Nicole —

Thanks for confirming POs. Attached is the final invoice (Redwood-invoice-20270428.pdf) split into two payable items:
- Invoice A (PO-MAR-442): March overage settlement — $1,187.00 (includes 10% courtesy credit and 18-session reduction)
- Invoice B (PO-APR-TOPUP-77): Pro-rated top-up for 50k reserved hours — $6,750.00

Payment instructions: wire to Redwood Inference, Acct ending 4821; reference the PO on each payment. If you prefer a single combined payment please reference both PO numbers.

DocuSign link for formal sign-off: https://docusign.com/Tx-ABC1234
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Andrew — let me know once AP has the POs live and we’ll mark the invoice as sent in collections. Appreciate the quick coordination here.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-invoice-20270428.pdf
